WhatsAbleAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In WhatsAble, open Settings > API keys and paste a live API key. Select the number access and scopes your operations need: numbers:read, templates:read, messages:read, messages:send, contacts:read, contacts:write and labels:write. The connection test reads the organization and API key with GET /v1/me; it does not verify all operation permissions.
